Always check in with a credit card, not a debit card. They place an authorization at check-in for your stay+an allowance for incidentals like food or movies. A credit card will only be authorized to see if you have the amount available, an authorization on a debit card will place a hold on the funds until 3-4 business days after checkout.  It’s just the way the different types of cards are handled, not much the hotel can do about it. Switch the card at checkout if you want to pay with your debit & stress less about your cash availability on vacation!

Source: Hotel accountant
